status: Current isolated remote evidence is c2test 0.17/schema14; see tests/CURRENT-VERIFICATION.md. Schema16 source runtime, bounded sealed SQLite recovery and explicit capture-native proof consumption have local evidence. Google is modeled in those tests; real Google, remote restore, online handoff, network/quota faults and annual qualification remain unverified. Production and automatic export are disabled
transport_gate: C2 routes are absent in production. Local or staging diagnostic routes require C2_TEST_KEY; the Form notification instead verifies a fresh Google bridge HMAC, team and writer epoch before reaching the DO. This gate is independent from the Coach session required by management reads.

response.envelope: Common Cloudflare success/failure envelope with request correlation and backend identity.
response.operation_result: Existing business mutations return immutable operation receipts and results. Source authority pin returns its own durable metadata without a business receipt; it and sync metadata import do not call Google or consume outbox.

/internal/c2/native-tab-proof.notes: Staging C2 transport gate plus current Coach. Observes Google Sheet.getFormUrl, resolves Form identity and verifies destination and numeric Tab. Response HMAC binds action/direction, fresh server nonce, request, original pin and time; current Coach and pin are rechecked after Google. This independent route does not mutate candidates. Explicit capture-native consumes the trusted RPC observation into its first durable request checkpoint and v2 candidate. Original pin/plan hash and legacy candidates stay unchanged; no source or annual promotion. Native transport permits at most one302/303 GET redirect to script.googleusercontent.com/macros/echo under one20-second deadline; actual Google compatibility remains unverified. NATIVE_TAB_PROOF_UNCONFIRMED is the fixed failure.

/internal/c2/restore-isolated-backup.notes: Optional named RecoveryRuntime binding to separate RecoveryState namespace. Current Coach pin and configured source identity rechecked; server-configured target allowlist and trusted expected manifest digest required. Only never-initialized target accepted. BUSINESS restores exact schema14/47 or16/51 snapshot into reviewed SQLite constraints/indexes, upgrades14 additively to16 with old47 data preserved except schema version. PRIVATE snapshot is independently authorized and bounded to16MB/128 records, preserving exact revisions, digests and raw bytes. Each restore commits/seals atomically. No business, authority, session, Google, alarm or polling activation exists on this target; recovery is a sealed isolated drill, with online handoff gated separately. RECOVERY_UNCONFIRMED is the fixed failure.

/internal/c2/private-source-run.notes: Staging-only C2_TEST_KEY and current Coach through named SourceRuntime/SourceAuthority. Actions: pin, register, capture, capture-native, stage, resume, review-view, review-append, backup. Client proofs/actor/pins are rejected. Explicit capture-native persists STARTED before trusted native RPC and preserves the confirmed original proof in checkpoint and v2 candidate observation; actor/attempt/pin/context/evidence digest are bound by candidate digest. Confirmed replay is validated before later REST, using original times; unknown replies are not refetched. Legacy capture/candidates remain declaration-only and original pin/core/plan digest are unchanged; summary states original response_tab_link_evidence. Current pin requires original actor/request; other-Coach delegation is not implemented. Google journal has core only, so native receipt recovery requires private DO/full private backup. Backup requires confirm_private_backup=true, current authorization and whole-object16,000,000 raw-byte/128-record/23,000,000 encoded-byte limits. Capture starts at most32 source requests including native; its first native request reserves2 external slots before STARTED. OAuth, REST and native reserve total at most40 per command. Review may reuse this invocation's successful Google journal observation while current authority/candidate/receipt/CAS remain checked. Fixed failure: SOURCE_PRIVATE_RUNTIME_UNCONFIRMED. Real Google/deployment/Free remain gated; SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED and annual_export_authorized=false remain fixed.

/internal/c2/pin-source-authority.notes: Protected source authority metadata only. C2 transport gate plus a current C1 Coach session are mandatory. Derives ended-season cutoff, actor, binding/generation/epoch and all database-known source IDs from SQLite; same season/request replays the original immutable pin and rechecks session and binding. It does not return source answers or tokens, accept a caller census, call Google, consume outbox, run business jobs or grant annual export. Census covers database-known IDs only; Tab binding remains a declaration.

/internal/c2/import-sync-foundation.notes: Versioned shadow import for unique per-season Google Form and Spreadsheet bindings, numeric Sheet tab IDs, explicit field mappings, normalized dependency-group baselines and exact stable Form or legacy source identities. Stable sources survive a binding-version increase without changing source_version when their content is unchanged. Same-version binding metadata may advance, but identity and mapping cannot drift; timestamps cannot regress. Omitted rows are not deletions. It creates no Google outbox and performs no external I/O.

/internal/c2/get-sync-overview.notes: Protected C2.1 diagnostic projection. File identifiers remain private. binding_current shows whether the stored binding matches the season version. Baseline count uses the active binding version; source counts cover the entire season, including unmoved mappings from older binding versions. Conflict, batch and business outbox counts cover the season.

/internal/c2/set-export-pause.notes: Coach-only per-season runtime pause is separate from imported binding metadata. PAUSING means an existing PREPARED/SENT/PARTIAL/FAILED batch still needs same-batch verification; no new batch can be prepared. Resume refuses unresolved batches. New batches re-read Google and compare B/C/G before preparation. This does not itself import a Google edit.

/internal/c2/retry-export.notes: Coach-only explicit re-arm after a non-retryable export failure. Does not itself write Google or erase a batch/outbox; the next poll reuses any unfinished batch, while a new batch performs a fresh B/C/G comparison. Optional outbox_id rearms only that unchanged current pending local event; omitted ID retains global retry and never clears local blocks.

/internal/c2/list-sync-conflicts.notes: Coach-only current-binding conflict summaries, ordered by stable conflict_id with a limit of 100. Full B/C/G evidence requires get-sync-conflict.

/internal/c2/get-sync-conflict.notes: Coach-only detail for one current-binding conflict; does not resolve or import it.

/internal/c2/list-form-reviews.notes: Coach-only, read-only page of unresolved Form answers. Each item exposes response_id, source_version, display_name, submitted_at and review_reason; cursor is the last response_id and limit is at most 100. It does not choose a member or merge by name. Resolve with the separate version-checked action after examining the season roster.

response: optional physical_integrity for SIGNUP or SEAT_PLAN_DRAFT
/internal/c2/check-sheet-differences.notes: C2.3 semantic B/C/G comparison and existing conflict behavior are unchanged. SIGNUP and SEAT_PLAN_DRAFT additionally return a separate read-only physical_integrity object using the same signed Google page, covering SignupsCurrent or SeatPlanState plus SeatPlanCurrent respectively. Its status does not alter the old semantic status, findings or conflict_records. Physical integrity compares complete display-value rows with v13 confirmed physical B and never writes physical findings into sync_conflicts. Empty Sheet plus empty physical B is INCOMPLETE because no baseline has been established; it does not assert pending outbox is drained.

/internal/c2/check-associated-physical-d.notes: Coach-protected, signed, manual read-only inspection of SIGNUP, SEAT_PLAN_DRAFT (state and current seats), SEAT_PLAN_CURRENT, or immutable SEAT_PLAN_REVISION. A full-row physical B is required; missing or invalid B cannot report OK. Findings identify scope, tab, stable row ID, Google row number, changed column names and B/G digests, but not full row values. At most 100 detailed findings are returned while findings_count and finding_types retain totals. B scans are capped at 5000 rows per tab and 2M total baseline characters; Google bridge limits are 5000 rows per tab, 100k cells and 2M characters. These limits return INCOMPLETE/bounded_limit, never clean. Binding changes and changes to fully materialized physical B during inspection return SHEET_INSPECTION_STALE. Over-limit B remains INCOMPLETE; an equal-size concurrent B change might not be detected as stale. This endpoint does not write Google, business rows, baselines, outbox or sync_conflicts; there is no automatic scan or repair.

/internal/c2/export-next-member.notes: Isolated, feature-gated C2.4 member and associated season roster-version slice. Each call returns IDLE, BATCH_CONFIRMED for one member, or EVENT_CONFIRMED after the existing system Seasons row and its captured roster_version have been verified. Member targets are exported one at a time; the outbox remains pending after the last member until the season row, its SYSTEM_VERSION baseline, and event are confirmed together. New member events capture roster_version when enqueued; legacy events without it stop before any Google write if later roster events exist. The request ID binds an immutable response; replay never advances another target. Requires complete season baselines and blocks Google edits. This slice does not export unrelated season_version changes.

/internal/c2/export-next-schedule.notes: Separately feature-gated C2.4 schedule exporter, enabled for explicit calls only in isolated c2test; original staging and production remain disabled. An expired SCHEDULE_CHANGED event must contain a complete transaction-captured snapshot; older events are rejected rather than reconstructed. One bounded row batch at a time exports templates, then the week, then practices, with durable before/target values, signed Google verification, same-batch retry, full mapped baselines, Coach and schedule reference checks. The existing system Seasons row receives that event's captured season_version as the last batch; only its verified receipt atomically confirms the event and season baseline. A final read detects edits to previously confirmed schedule rows. Google cross-tab writes are not atomic.

/internal/c2/export-next-associated.notes: C2.4 isolated signup and seating exporter. Strict immutable SIGNUPS_CHANGED or SEATING_CHANGED snapshots and per-practice cursor order. Each call sends one recoverable signed batch of up to four adjacent rows from one physical tab within the bridge payload budget, in signup, complete draft-seat, published-revision, then state order. An existing Google row must match its full physical B; first and final stages verify practice, member and actor references. The event stays pending through partial cross-tab writes. Only after final Google reread of every target and exact full-draft seat identity check do logical B, physical B, cursor and outbox advance in one SQLite transaction. A lost bridge reply retries the original batch. Old snapshots, version gaps, manual Google edits, and missing baselines stop before a new write. Deployment and evidence are maintained in CURRENT-STATUS.md and tests/CURRENT-VERIFICATION.md; no production access.

/internal/c2/poll-due-exports.notes: Feature-gated ten-minute scheduler. Processes at most four due seasons per tick; a signup or seating event may advance through up to eight four-row batches for that season, stopping at its event boundary. Other exporters advance one batch per season per tick. Retryable failures use durable per-season SQLite backoff capped at six hours. Non-retryable errors halt that season with ACTION_REQUIRED until a Coach explicitly re-arms it; outbox and unfinished batches remain intact. Disabled in every deployed configuration.

/internal/c2/pull-form-responses.notes: Signed, read-only Apps Script Form page; the Worker verifies response scope and atomically commits members, stable source mappings, review observations, the cursor and an immutable receipt. A 24-hour overlap and (timestamp, response ID) page cursor avoid missing equal-timestamp answers; retries reuse the same request ID. Only local or isolated staging test key may call it.

/internal/c2/form-submit-notification.notes: An installable Google Forms submit trigger signs a fresh notification with the existing bridge secret. The Worker verifies its scope before reaching the DO, checks the current season binding, then uses the normal transactional Form pull; the response must be observed or a retryable failure is returned. This staging-only route does not expose the C2 transport key to Google. Installation is explicit while the production Apps Script legacy trigger still owns the live season.

/internal/c2/poll-active-forms.notes: Ten-minute staging scheduler entrypoint, disabled by default and unavailable in production. It processes at most four current bound OPEN or COMPLETED seasons until a successful full Form scan after season_ends_at, using the same transactional pull path; failed seasons report RETRY_REQUIRED for a later scheduled invocation.

/internal/c2/resolve-form-source.notes: Coach resolution for a reviewed Form answer. Requires current source version, an existing same-season member and no prior Form mapping for that member; it preserves the member identity and name override. It is a protected C2 staging action, not a normal join approval.

/internal/c2/list-export-blocks.notes: Lists current pending local lane blocks by immutable event sequence; no raw Google cells.
